The largest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.

Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy technique, myofascial release therapy appears to be an effective intervention for specific conditions, particularly myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, this technique aims to alleviate restrictions in motion and reduce pain. The mechanism involves targeting sensitive points within the muscles, which can help relieve discomfort and improve the range of motion. This suggests that myofascial release is beneficial for patients suffering from chronic pain related to fascial restrictions and muscle tension.
